trajectory_summary: A short, low-friction call where the customer stayed cooperative throughout but the rep ran the script surface-level, missing two chances to probe the customer's prior solar experience and fumbling the bill capture into an unclear number. The call ends on an unanchored callback rather than a locked appointment.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag unknown; this should be scored as callback, not booked or tentative — no day/time was set, only 'tomorrow in the morning' with no specific time.
